LightingLevelBar.description: State of the 10-segment level bar drawn by vcu_level_bar_update_hysteresis. The bar dithers between two neighbouring levels so that a value between two 5 percent steps looks smooth.

fields.name: lower_pct
fields.description: Lower of the two neighbouring bar levels, in percent (0..100). The bar lights floor(lower_pct / 10) segments when it redraws at dither phase 119.

fields.name: upper_pct
fields.description: Upper of the two neighbouring bar levels, in percent (0..100). The bar lights floor(upper_pct / 10) segments when it redraws at dither phase 60.

fields.name: dither_phase
fields.description: Dither phase counter, 0..119. The counter wraps to 0 after 119 (the character 'w'). Each call advances it by one; the bar redraws only when the previous value was 60 or 119.

LightingBrightness.description: LED brightness state written by lighting_brightness_percent_set: the displayed level, a software PWM phase counter and the requested target.

fields.name: current_pct
fields.description: Current brightness in percent, moved toward the request in steps of 5 (probably). The code saturates it at 109 (0x6d).

fields.name: pwm_phase
fields.description: Software PWM phase counter. It increments on each refresh and resets to 0 after the wrap; the LED is on while the target is not less than this phase (probably).

fields.name: target_pct
fields.description: Requested brightness, 0..100 percent. Set by lighting_brightness_percent_set through FUN_0800f050(level, 0, 100, 10).

LightingSweepState.description: State of the channel-sweep lighting animation in vcu_channel_sweep_animation. Mode 0 turns all groups on; mode 1 runs the sweep.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Sweep position, counted in sweep steps. It runs from 0 to twice lighting_sweep_channel_count and then restarts at 0 (probably).

fields.name: mode_latched
fields.description: Animation mode last applied (0 = all on, 1 = sweep). It is copied from mode_now when the requested mode changes.

fields.name: mode_now
fields.description: Animation mode requested this tick, taken from bit 6 of DAT_20001e68 (0 or 1).
